content: According to the HR policy, what pay rate applies to hours worked beyond the first 2 extra hours of overtime? Answer in one sentence, citing the specific rate.

I need to check the exact policy wording for hours beyond the first 2 extra hours, since the digest only covers the initial 2-hour threshold and doesn't specify what happens after that.The query returned the full text, which states: "Any hours beyond that are paid at double time under this policy" — so per the HR policy (hr-policy.pdf, captured 2026-08-02), any hours worked beyond the first 2 extra hours of overtime are paid at **double time**.
